name: Pause screen (iPhone shield)
desc: TH-953 proposal for owner review (H32). Copy needs clinical/legal review. iPhone system shield (UnplugShield, ShieldConfiguration). Apple allows only an icon (here the Tether app icon), a title, a subtitle and two buttons, so this screen uses nothing else. Colors and text come from the shared intercept tokens. Not an app route: reference for TH-968. A ShieldAction cannot open Tether directly; the proposal is a local notification the person taps to finish the small step (needs device validation, H39).
